purpose: Distinguish composition failures present in saved initial checkpoints from behavior lost during the fixed 128 workflow updates. Descriptive paired diagnosis of a failure already observed on TEST; no new confirmatory held-out claim.
checkpoints: Exactly each completed original result.transfer[condition].initial_checkpoint and transfer/<condition>/checkpoint at 128 updates. No checkpoint search or selection.
initial_reload: Require full generated-record equality on all five original initial DEV panels before reading/evaluating original TEST for that condition. Record mismatch and skip that condition's further panels.
final_original: Use immutable saved final records, regrade them under the frozen scorer and verify artifact hashes. Independent dispatched persistence audits cover their separate-process reproduction.
scoring: Frozen BF16 base, FP32 adapters/offsets, snapshot hashes, one ROCm GPU/nooffload/finite guard, tokenizer/chat template, native generation, original order and batch size, EOS, max_new_tokens=192 and full strict JSON semantic execution. No token restriction or output repair.
explanation: Per-pattern format/execution/state errors, emitted and expected operation sequences, whether failed outputs reuse TRAIN operation plans, per-step argument differences, state divergence, and deterministic raw failure examples. Pair each exact input across initial/final into retained, lost, gained, wrong_at_both; canonical-call differences never replace semantic scoring.

fresh_inputs.method: Original make_example with source data_seed + fixed seed_offset, original aliases, new scenes, and explicit posthoc_diagnostic split. Check scene/prompt disjointness from the full original corpus before model load.
fresh_inputs.evaluation: Both initial and final checkpoints; 32 new inputs per condition and 64 generated answers. Same frozen scorer. Input set is generated and saved before any model evaluation.
fresh_inputs.boundary: Posthoc diagnostic replication on fresh scenes, not a new unbiased held-out benchmark. Lexical operation parameters and request templates are unchanged.
fresh_inputs.reordered_plans: Not included: the inspected text operations are order-dependent, so permuting them would change the requested result.

source_proof: Completed source result and execution, exit0/no timeout, embedded task/config/source hashes, archived original 20-file bundle and all consumed artifact hashes. Freeze all 33 previous deployable dependencies by actual file hashes.
process_proof: New supervised task and attempt, standalone diagnose_initial.py from actual hashed code directory, source completed before start. Record supervisor/launcher and actual CLI/parent PIDs without equating launcher and CLI or using numeric PID inequality as sole evidence.
scope: Synthetic explicit three-step tool composition; schema identity clues, one optimization seed, and four jointly varied task-family/order/convention/data streams remain limitations.
